subject: [RFC PATCH v3 05/14] mm/memcontrol: Set tier limits proportional to memory limits

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch introduces proportional tier limits based on memory limits when users write to memory limit sysfs files or when memory hotplug causes tier proportions to shift. The system must have tiered memcg limits enabled for this patch to take effect. It modifies the Linux kernel's memory control and memory tiers code, adding new functions and modifying existing ones to implement proportional tier limits. This change aims to improve the management of memory resources in a multi-tenant environment.
